name: Zhezhi

tierList.prydwen: Hybrid: T3 Tower of Adversity, T4 Whimpering Wastes

kit.intro: 5-star Glacio Rectifier Hybrid buffing Glacio and Resonance Skill DMG, with strong off-field Coordinated Attack damage via summoned Inklit Spirits. Teleports to placed 'Phantasmic Imprint' markers for quick, consistent, hard-to-interrupt damage. Considered powercrept since her best partners (Jinhsi, Carlotta) have been overshadowed by newer releases.

skills.normalAttack: Basic Attack - Dimming Brush (3 hits), Glacio.
skills.resonanceSkill: Manifestation - Glacio hit, at 60+ Afflatus summons Phantasmic Imprint Left+Right.
skills.forte: Ink and Wash - governs Afflatus (max 90) -> Phantasmic Imprint placement -> Heavy Attack: Conjuration -> Stroke of Genius/Creation's Zenith (teleport to Imprint, Painter's Delight stacks).
skills.liberation: Living Canvas - summons Inklit Spirits that perform Coordinated Attacks (up to 21) whenever the active Resonator deals damage, for 30s.
skills.intro: Radiant Ruin - Glacio strike, builds Afflatus.
skills.outro: Carve and Draw - 20% Glacio DMG / 25% Resonance Skill DMG Amplification to next character for 14s or until swap; restores 15 Resonance Energy to them.

echoSet: Empyrean Anthem (best with endgame Echo investment + 5-star weapon - 80% Coordinated DMG)
Moonlit Clouds (better otherwise - 22.5% ATK to next character on Outro)

teams.name: Carlotta Team
teams.notes: Zhezhi's best DPS partner since 2.0 - fully utilizes her buff kit.

teams.name: Jinhsi Team
teams.notes: Only Coordinated Attacker who rotates fast without needing her Ultimate, plus Skill DMG Amplify.

teams.name: Lingyang Team
teams.notes: Acceptable fallback with a well-built team.

rotation: Intro -> Basic 1,2,3 -> Skill -> Heavy: Conjuration -> Skill: Stroke of Genius (jump-cancel) -> Stroke of Genius (cancel via Ultimate) -> Ultimate -> Skill: Creation's Zenith (dash-cancel) -> Echo -> Outro.
communityNotes: Prydwen: one of the strongest off-field damage Hybrids in the game with an easy, consistent, quick rotation and no signature-weapon dependency, but powercrept overall - her niche Resonance Skill DMG buff only matters for Jinhsi/Carlotta, both since overshadowed by newer DPS, and she has very low quickswap headroom and poor Sequence scaling as a version-1 character.
